summary: Comprehensive iter73 audit across all tabs/KPIs/rows on the preview DB. 29 passed, 4 skipped (thin seed data), 0 failed. All numerical invariants hold: (1) my_products my_price >= original_price (iter73i phantom-sale heal); (2) diff_pct = round((comp_min - my_price)/my_price*100); (3) Top Brands has no 'Unknown' bucket and market_share_pct sums to 100 within tolerance when populated (iter73h); (4) leaderboard-vs-store-ranking revenue totals reconcile (both currently 0 on preview — thin data, invariant is trivially true); (5) store-ranking sorted_by='revenue_desc', monotonic on rows that have revenue, own store present with revenue_status='accumulating' (iter73k fallback); (6) /api/discounts/top-pct?days=90 responds in <5s (iter73g regression guard); (7) scanner saving_sar = my_price - comp_min & saving_pct math correct; (8) alerts carry valid triggered_at. Frontend visual scan across /, my-products, price-intel, insights, scanner, discounts, alerts, stores → ZERO occurrences of 'NaN', 'undefined', '[object Object]', '$NaN', '0.NaN', '-Infinity' anywhere in rendered DOM. UI renders '0 SAR' and '0%' for zero-activity KPIs which is correct (not fabricated). Target SKU 8595602540877 for iter73l phantom-sale detail heal is NOT present in the preview DB (404), so that specific canonical VAT case cannot be verified here — needs prod DB or seeded preview.

Without this, ~4 hard invariants can only be verified in prod, not preview.

Consider surfacing revenue_status='accumulating' / 'insufficient_history' as an explicit UI badge on Insights Leaderboard rows — currently those rows show '0 SAR' with no indication that the number is 'not yet computable' vs 'zero revenue'. Cosmetic, not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~9200 lines with 100+ routes — modularise into feature routers (auth / stores / my_products / price_intel / insights / discounts / scanner / alerts / crawler_ingest) for maintainability. Not urgent but blocking further growth.

_insights_summary_compute and _price_intel_dashboard_compute both re-derive brand + effective-price per product in-memory on every call. If the preview DB scales past a few thousand products, dashboard latency will regress. Consider caching per-window compute results (TTL 5-15min) via the existing page-cache pattern.

/api/insights/leaderboard returns a plain list while /api/price-intel/store-ranking returns a dict with 'stores' key — inconsistent shape. Callers on the frontend already normalise this, but a stable dict-with-metadata shape (plus 'sorted_by', 'window_days', 'total') on both would prevent frontend drift.

Zero-activity KPIs render as '0 SAR' / '0%' which is technically correct but visually indistinguishable from a real-zero. Add a lightweight tooltip or dim style when revenue_status ∈ {accumulating, insufficient_history} so users don't misread 'no data yet' as 'zero performance'.
